mentions.name: Tenderlane
mentions.description: This app lets freight forwarders upload an entire tender specification and get an overview of what the customer wants in minutes instead of the days or weeks it typically takes. It uses Excel as the frontend, with workflows for filling, uploading, and downloading Excel files, and is built with Elixir/Phoenix LiveView.
mentions.problem: Freight forwarders spend days or weeks understanding and answering tenders without even knowing if they'll win the bid.
mentions.audience: Freight forwarders (logistics businesses that respond to customer tenders)
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on Tenderlane: https://tenderlane.app/

Freight forwarders spend days or sometimes even weeks understanding and answering tenders without even knowing if they'll win the bid!

With Tenderlane, they can now upload the entire tender spec and get an overview of what the customer wants in minutes instead.
